item.title: Alabama volunteer rescue group collects donations to help Mississippi community following ice storm
item.description: A group of volunteers is collecting donations to take to Mississippi after January's ice storm. The Childersburg Rescue Squad plans to drive supplies to Oxford on Saturday.

item.title: Fire destroys historic St. Clair County church before 148th anniversary celebration
